$comment: Console-to-application tenant profile message. Owned by Console; TITU Work and Admin keep a byte-identical copy (`bun run contracts:check`), Market's samples live in market-control-plane.json. The request and response schemas are published in schemas.json (profileRequest, profileResult) with accepted and refused samples in fixtures.json.

refusedRequests.name: former-slug-is-current
refusedRequests.note: the current slug is never its own alias

refusedRequests.name: reserved-slug
refusedRequests.note: a reserved word (reserved-slugs.json) is a registration rule: the shape is valid, the receiver still refuses it

semantics.version: profile_version of the tenant in Console. Provisioning is implicitly version 1, so a profile event is version 2 or later.
semantics.eventId: profile:<sha256 of the Console operation id>, fixed length.
semantics.formerSlugs: Every slug the tenant has retired, distinct, never containing slug. The receiver replaces the tenant's alias set with it.
semantics.notProvisioned: TITU Work and Admin: 404 TENANT_NOT_FOUND for a tenant they have not provisioned. Market: 404 TENANT_NOT_FOUND for an unknown tenant, 503 TENANT_NOT_READY for one that exists but is not ready. Console only sends the event after the application applied the tenant's provisioning, and retries a 503.
semantics.olderVersion: version lower than the stored one: status superseded, the stored name and slug are answered, nothing changes.
semantics.sameVersion: Idempotent when name, slug and formerSlugs equal the stored ones (status applied); 409 VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise.
semantics.newerVersion: In one transaction: set name and slug, replace the alias set with formerSlugs, store the version (status applied). If slug or any formerSlug is another tenant's slug or alias: 409 SLUG_CONFLICT and nothing is written.
semantics.answer: acceptedVersion and appliedVersion are the receiver's stored profile version after handling and are always equal; name and slug are the receiver's current values.
semantics.overview: tenant-overview and tenant-status report the receiver's current slug. Console also accepts a slug the tenant retired while the application has not applied a rename.
semantics.invalid: 400 INVALID_INPUT for a body that fails the strict schema (version below 2, formerSlugs repeating or containing slug, unknown field) and for a slug that is a reserved word. Console stops retrying it.
